commands.command: set -eu; EXPECTED=460ef8647f7e2d56cdc56d90e6f5c5cd874a5462; SERIAL=RFCT70L7E8J; PKG=pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge; export ANDROID_HOME="$HOME/Library/Android/sdk"; export ANDROID_SDK_ROOT="$ANDROID_HOME"; GRADLE_BIN="$HOME/.gradle/local-agent/gradle-9.6.0/bin/gradle"; git fetch origin main; git checkout main; git reset --hard origin/main; git clean -fd; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; python3 -m py_compile scripts/local_phone_llm_live_call.py; CALL_STATE=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys telephony.registry | sed -n 's/.*mCallState=\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -1); test "$CALL_STATE" = 0; echo endpointing_call_state_before=$CALL_STATE; INITIAL_LLM=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell pidof llama-server 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r' || true); echo endpointing_initial_llama_pid=${INITIAL_LLM:-none}; "$GRADLE_BIN" :app:assembleDebug >/tmp/live-endpointing-build.log 2>&1 || { cat /tmp/live-endpointing-build.log; exit 1; }; adb -s "$SERIAL" install -r app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk >/tmp/live-endpointing-install.log 2>&1 || { cat /tmp/live-endpointing-install.log; exit 1; }; PYTHONPATH=scripts python3 scripts/local_phone_llm_live_call.py "$SERIAL" | tee /tmp/live-endpointing-orange.log; grep -q '^allowlisted_target=510100100$' /tmp/live-endpointing-orange.log; grep -q '^endpointing=trailing_silence$' /tmp/live-endpointing-orange.log; grep -q '^endpoint_reason=trailing_silence$' /tmp/live-endpointing-orange.log; grep -q '^endpoint_speech_detected=true$' /tmp/live-endpointing-orange.log; grep -q '^end_of_speech_to_first_tx_ms=' /tmp/live-endpointing-orange.log; grep -q '^live_endpointing_proven_s22=true' /tmp/live-endpointing-orange.log; grep -q '^local_phone_llm_orange_live_turn_proven_s22=true$' /tmp/live-endpointing-orange.log; grep -q '^hangup_requested=true$' /tmp/live-endpointing-orange.log; grep -q '^idle_after_hangup=True$' /tmp/live-endpointing-orange.log; sleep 6; test -z "$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell pidof llama-server 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r' || true)"; test -z "$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell pidof "$PKG:call_media" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r' || true)"; CALL_STATE_AFTER=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys telephony.registry | sed -n 's/.*mCallState=\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -1); test "$CALL_STATE_AFTER" = 0; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; echo live_endpointing_orange_proven_s22=true
